verdict.summary: The validation now resolves the newly registered handle by exact-match cardinality and fails closed on both zero and multiple parsed catalog records, eliminating the prior last-record-wins ambiguity while preserving the nonempty-model guard. The added self-tests execute the workflow's extracted production fragment, cover both duplicate orderings, zero matches, the valid singleton, and an empty-model singleton, and explicitly verify sentinel/step extraction failure; these assertions are non-vacuous and would fail under the prior dict-comprehension behavior. No trust check, permission boundary, token handling, or workflow action pinning is weakened by this scoped change.
